-- MINI CHANGELOG --

quickhiding/timid patch & pacing fixes


quickhiding now only affects your ENTRANCE to the closet, granting you the ability to slam your locker/open the locker doors and stay there instead of getting forced out like timid closets
quickhiding and timid work now
surge nerfed slightly in speed
surge spawnrates heightened

pacing changes
every run, it randomly chooses from surge & limbo on door like. 25-30ish, and thats the entity youll be having to deal with for those doors in that run
door 50-60 (close to jeff's shop, 1/3rd of the game) enables both of them


-- INFO --

DOORS Hardcore: Reignited is the official Doors Hardcore experience on Roblox. (this game is not meant for popularity or money, it's a creative outlet :3 have funnn)

It's for the best of the best. Don't play it if you're a casual DOORS player or if you don't like chaos and anxiety-inducing situations.

(THIS GAME IS NOT RECOMMENDED FOR EPILEPTIC PEOPLE OR FOR PEOPLE SENSITIVE TO LOUD NOISES!!!!)
